en.t: Liu Che, posthumously known as Emperor Wu of Han, assumes the throne over the Han dynasty of China
en.s: Emperor Wu of Han (156 – 29 March 87 BC) (Chinese: 漢武帝; pinyin: Hàn Wŭdì), personal name Liu Che (Chinese: 劉徹; pinyin: Liú Chè) and courtesy name Tong (Chinese: 通; pinyin: Tōng), was the seventh emperor of the Han dynasty from 141 to 87 BC. His reign lasted 54 years – a record not broken until the reign of the Kangxi Emperor more than 1,800 years later – and remains the record for ethnic Han emperors.

zh.s: 公元前141年3月9日，刘彻继承西汉皇位，成为汉武帝。

en.t: A crowd attacks Constantine IX during a procession in Constantinople
en.s: On March 9, 1044, unrest broke out during Emperor Constantine IX’s procession in Constantinople. Anger centred on his relationship with Maria Skleraina and fears for Empress Zoe and her sister Theodora. The two empresses appeared to reassure the crowd, helping restore order.
en.n: The date follows the source’s historical chronology; no conversion to a modern calendar has been applied.

zh.t: 君士坦丁堡民众在君士坦丁九世出行时骚乱
zh.s: 1044年3月9日，君士坦丁九世皇帝在君士坦丁堡参加宗教游行时遭遇骚乱。民众不满他与玛丽亚·斯克莱莱娜的关系，并担心佐伊女皇和妹妹狄奥多拉的安全。两位女皇出面安抚，局势才逐渐平息。
zh.n: 日期沿用来源所列的历史纪年，未换算为现代历法。

en.s: The Battle of Klokotnitsa (Bulgarian: Битката при Клокотница, Bitkata pri Klokotnitsa) occurred on 9 March 1230 near the village of Klokotnitsa (today in Haskovo Province, Bulgaria). As a result, the Second Bulgarian Empire emerged once again as the most powerful state in South-Eastern Europe and the power of the Empire of Thessalonica faded.

zh.s: 克洛科特尼察战役于1230年3月9日在克洛科特尼察村附近发生，该村今属保加利亚哈斯科沃州。战后，保加利亚第二帝国再次成为东南欧最强大的国家，塞萨洛尼基帝国则走向衰落。

en.s: The Battle of Beas River took place between the Chagatai Khanate and the Mamluk Sultanate of Delhi on 9 March 1285. Ghiyas ud din Balban arranged a military defense line across the Beas River as part of his "blood and iron" fortification chain strategy at Multan and Lahore as a countermeasure against the Chagatai Khanate invasion. Balban managed to repulse the invasion.

zh.s: 1285年3月9日，察合台汗国与德里马穆鲁克苏丹国在比阿斯河交战。吉亚斯·乌德·丁·巴尔班按照“铁血”防御策略，在比阿斯河沿岸修筑防线，并在木尔坦和拉合尔建立防御链，以抵挡察合台汗国入侵。巴尔班成功击退了入侵军。

en.t: Cabral’s fleet leaves Lisbon for India
en.s: On March 9, 1500, Pedro Álvares Cabral’s fleet departed from Lisbon for India. The expedition later reached the coast of what is now Brazil before continuing its voyage east.
en.n: This records departure from Lisbon; the arrival in Brazil came in April.

zh.t: 卡布拉尔率领船队从里斯本出发前往印度
zh.s: 1500年3月9日，佩德罗·阿尔瓦雷斯·卡布拉尔率领船队从里斯本出发前往印度。船队后来先抵达今天巴西的海岸，再继续向东航行。
zh.n: 这里记录从里斯本启航，船队抵达巴西是在4月。

en.s: The Battle of Shimbra Kure was fought on 9 March 1529 between the forces of Adal led by Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi, and the Abyssinian army, under Dawit II (Lebna Dengel). It was the first major battle of the Ethiopian–Adal War. Arab Faqīh states numerous Somalis on the left flank fled while the Abyssinians pursued killing a large number of their men, but the Harla on the right flank held their ground.

zh.s: 1529年3月9日，阿达尔军队与阿比西尼亚军队在辛布拉库雷交战。阿达尔军由伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐率领，阿比西尼亚军由达维特二世（勒布纳·登格尔）率领。这是埃塞俄比亚—阿达尔战争的第一场大战。阿拉伯史家法基赫称，左翼的索马里人溃逃，阿比西尼亚军乘势追击，杀死大量士兵；右翼的哈拉人则坚守阵地。

en.s: The Ethiopian–Adal War, also known as the Abyssinian–Adal War and Futūḥ Al-Ḥabaša (Arabic: فتوح الحبش, lit. 'Conquest of Abyssinia'), was a war fought between the Christian Ethiopian Empire and the Muslim Adal Sultanate from 1529 to 1543. The Christian Ethiopian troops were drawn mainly from Tigray, Gojjam, Begemder, Angot, Qeda,,Gan, Medri Bahri, Gafat, and a certain numbers of Agaw troops At the closing of the war, the Christian forces were supported by the Portuguese Empire with no less than 400 musketeers.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 埃塞俄比亚—阿达尔战争
zh.s: 1529年3月9日至1543年2月21日，埃塞俄比亚帝国与阿达尔苏丹国交战，战争后期葡萄牙军队援助埃塞俄比亚。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的战争开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Sezawa was the first major battle fought by Takeda Shingen in his campaign to gain control of Shinano Province. He took on and defeated a coalition of Shinano daimyō including the leaders of the Suwa, Ogasawara and Murakami clans.

zh.s: 濑泽之战是武田信玄为夺取信浓国控制权而发动的战役中，他首次参加的一场大型战斗。他迎战并击败了一支由信浓大名组成的联军，其中包括诹访、小笠原和村上氏族的首领。

en.s: The Battle of Bamberg took place on 9 March 1632 during the Thirty Years' War. The army of the Catholic League led by Count Tilly surprised and routed the Swedes led by Gustav Horn and captured the city.

zh.s: 1632年3月9日，三十年战争期间，蒂利伯爵率领的天主教联盟军队突然袭击古斯塔夫·霍恩率领的瑞典军队，将其击溃并攻占班贝格。

en.s: The Battle of Høland (Swedish: Slaget vid Høland) was two minor skirmishes that were fought on 9 March 1716 in Høland, Norway as a part of the 1716 Swedish invasion of Norway, during the Great Northern War.

zh.s: 赫兰战役是1716年3月9日在挪威赫兰发生的两场小规模战斗，属于大北方战争期间瑞典于1716年入侵挪威的作战行动。

en.s: The Mapuche uprising of 1723 was a rebellion of the Mapuche (an Indigenous people of western South America) against the Spanish Empire and its colonial administration in present-day Chile. It began with the killing of Pascual Delgado by Mapuches and continued until Mapuche factions begun to sue for peace in 1725. The Spanish reinforced the fort of Purén, and most of the Spanish managed to find refuge in the various forts without being intercepted or harassed by Mapuches.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1723年马普切起义是南美洲西部原住民族马普切人反抗西班牙帝国及其殖民统治的一场叛乱，发生在今智利境内。起义由马普切人杀死帕斯夸尔·德尔加多引发，持续至1725年部分马普切派别开始求和。西班牙人增援普伦堡垒，大多数西班牙人得以躲进各处堡垒，没有遭到马普切人拦截或袭击。
zh.n: 此条采用原文资料框列出的起义开始日期。

en.t: Adam Smith’s The Wealth of Nations is published
en.s: On March 9, 1776, Adam Smith’s The Wealth of Nations was published in London by W. Strahan and T. Cadell. The book examined how commercial societies generate wealth and became a foundational work of classical economics.

zh.t: 亚当·斯密的《国富论》出版
zh.s: 1776年3月9日，亚当·斯密的《国富论》由W.斯特拉恩和T.卡德尔在伦敦出版。这本书探讨商业社会如何创造财富，后来成为古典经济学的奠基著作。

en.s: The Battle of Grand Turk was a battle that occurred on 9 March 1783 during the Anglo-French War. France had seized the Turks and Caicos archipelago, islets of rich salt works, seizing Grand Turk in February 1783. The British responded by deploying 28-gun frigate HMS Albermarle with a force of more than 100 men under the command of Captain Horatio Nelson. Although the mission failed, the islands were restored to Britain in the second Treaty of Paris that formally concluded the war.

zh.s: 大特克岛战役于1783年3月9日发生，是英法战争中的一场战斗。法国此前夺取了拥有丰厚盐业资源的特克斯和凯科斯群岛，并于1783年2月占领大特克岛。英国派出配备28门炮的‘阿尔伯马尔’号护卫舰，由霍雷肖·纳尔逊舰长率领100多名军人应战。虽然行动失败，但正式结束战争的第二份《巴黎条约》仍将这些岛屿归还英国。

en.s: The 1784 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 9, 1784, in order to elect the First President of New Hampshire. (The office would be renamed to Governor in 1792.) Former Non-Partisan Chief Justice of the New Hampshire Superior Court of Judicature Meshech Weare won the election as he was the only candidate.

zh.s: 1784年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月9日举行，选出首任州主席；该职位于1792年改称州长。无党派人士、前州高等法院首席法官梅谢克·韦尔作为唯一候选人当选。

en.s: The 1790 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 9, 1790, in order to elect the President of New Hampshire. (The office would be renamed to Governor in 1792.) Third time Anti-Federalist candidate Josiah Bartlett defeated former Acting President John Pickering, Joshua Wentworth and former delegate to the Continental Congress Nathaniel Peabody.

zh.s: 1790年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月9日举行。当时该职位称‘州主席’，1792年才改称‘州长’。第三次参选的反联邦党人乔赛亚·巴特利特，击败前代理主席约翰·皮克林、约书亚·温特沃思，以及前大陆会议代表纳撒尼尔·皮博迪。

en.s: The 1802 New Hampshire gubernatorial election took place on March 9, 1802. to elect the Governor of New Hampshire. Federalist candidate and incumbent Governor of New Hampshire John Taylor Gilman won re-election to a ninth term, defeating Democratic-Republic candidate and former Governor and United States Senator John Langdon.

zh.s: 1802年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月9日举行。现任州长、联邦党候选人约翰·泰勒·吉尔曼击败民主共和党候选人、前州长兼前联邦参议员约翰·兰登，赢得第9个任期。

en.s: The Battle of Campo Tenese (9 March 1806) saw two divisions of the French Army of Naples led by Jean Reynier attack the left wing of the Royal Neapolitan Army under Roger de Damas. Though the defenders were protected by field fortifications, a French frontal attack combined with a turning movement rapidly overran the position and routed the Neapolitans with heavy losses.

zh.s: 1806年3月9日，法军那不勒斯军团的两个师在让·雷尼耶率领下，进攻罗歇·德·达马指挥的那不勒斯王国军队左翼。尽管守军有野战工事保护，法军仍以正面进攻配合迂回，迅速突破阵地，击溃那不勒斯军队，使其损失惨重。这场战斗称为坎波泰内塞战役。

en.s: The Battle of Tacuarí (9 March 1811) was a battle in Southern Paraguay between revolutionary forces under the command of General Manuel Belgrano, member of the Primera Junta government of Argentina, and Paraguayan troops under colonel Manuel Atanasio Cabañas, at the time at the service of the royalists.

zh.s: 塔夸里战役于1811年3月9日在巴拉圭南部发生。交战双方是曼努埃尔·贝尔格拉诺将军率领的革命军，以及当时为保王派效力、由曼努埃尔·阿塔纳西奥·卡瓦尼亚斯上校率领的巴拉圭军队。贝尔格拉诺也是阿根廷第一届执政委员会的成员。

en.s: Allemand's escape from Lorient was an episode of the naval operations of the French Navy in 1812. A number of French, warships trapped in Lorient by the British blockade, managed to take to the sea under Zacharie Allemand and sail to Brest. British squadrons sailed in pursuit, but were unable to force the French fleet into action.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1812年法国海军行动期间，扎卡里·阿勒芒率领数艘被英国封锁在洛里昂的法国军舰突围出海，驶往布雷斯特。英国舰队随后追击，但未能迫使法国舰队交战。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The 1813 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 9, 1813. Incumbent Democratic-Republican Governor William Plumer was defeated by Federalist nominee John Taylor Gilman.

zh.s: 1813年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月9日举行。现任民主共和党州长威廉·普卢默败给联邦党候选人约翰·泰勒·吉尔曼。

en.s: The 1819 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 9, 1819. Incumbent Democratic-Republican Governor William Plumer did not run for re-election. Democratic-Republican nominee Samuel Bell defeated Federalist nominee William Hale.

zh.s: 1819年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月9日举行。现任民主共和党州长威廉·普卢默不再寻求连任。同党候选人塞缪尔·贝尔击败联邦党候选人威廉·黑尔。

en.s: The 1824 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 9, 1824, in order to elect the governor of New Hampshire. Former Democratic-Republican United States senator from New Hampshire David L. Morril defeated incumbent Democratic-Republican governor Levi Woodbury and former Federalist governor Jeremiah Smith. Since no candidate received a majority in the popular vote, Morril was elected by the New Hampshire General Court per the state constitution.

zh.s: 1824年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月9日举行。民主共和党人、该州前联邦参议员大卫·L.莫里尔击败同党现任州长利瓦伊·伍德伯里，以及前联邦党州长杰里迈亚·史密斯。由于没有候选人获得过半选民票，州议会依据州宪法选出莫里尔担任州长。

en.s: The 1830 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 9, 1830. Incumbent Democratic Governor Benjamin Pierce did not stand for re-election. Democratic nominee Matthew Harvey defeated National Republican nominee Timothy Upham with 54.70% of the vote.

zh.s: 1830年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月9日举行。现任民主党州长本杰明·皮尔斯不再寻求连任。民主党候选人马修·哈维以54.70%的得票率击败国家共和党候选人蒂莫西·厄普姆。

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in the Republic of New Granada on 9 March 1832. Francisco de Paula Santander was elected president, whilst José Ignacio de Márquez was elected vice president.

zh.s: 新格拉纳达共和国于1832年3月9日举行间接总统选举。弗朗西斯科·德·保拉·桑坦德当选总统，何塞·伊格纳西奥·德·马尔克斯当选副总统。

en.s: The Battle of Gawakuke was an engagement fought between the Sokoto Caliphate and the Gobir city-state at Gawakuke in northern Nigeria on 9 March 1836. The battle was a victory for Sokoto, and secured the Gobir kingdom's subordination to the caliphate. In 1836, the Gobir kingdom revolted against the powerful Sokoto Caliphate, which had ruled Gobir since its initial conquest in 1808.

zh.s: 1836年3月9日，索科托哈里发国与戈比尔城邦在今尼日利亚北部的加瓦库克交战。索科托获胜，确保戈比尔王国继续臣属于哈里发国。索科托自1808年首次征服戈比尔后便统治当地；1836年，戈比尔王国起而反抗这个强大的哈里发国。

en.s: The 1841 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 9, 1841. Incumbent Democratic Governor John Page defeated Whig nominee Enos Stevens with 56.33% of the vote in a re-match of the previous year's election.

zh.s: 1841年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月9日举行。现任民主党州长约翰·佩奇以56.33%的得票率，再次击败辉格党候选人伊诺斯·史蒂文斯，两人曾在前一年的选举中交锋。

en.s: United States v. Schooner Amistad, 40 U.S. (15 Pet.) 518 (1841), was a United States Supreme Court case resulting from the rebellion of Africans on board the Spanish schooner La Amistad in 1839. It was an unusual freedom suit that involved international diplomacy as well as United States law. The historian Samuel Eliot Morison described it in 1969 as the most important court case involving slavery before being eclipsed by that of Dred Scott v.
en.n: This entry records the decision, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 美国诉“阿米斯塔德”号案
zh.s: 美国诉“阿米斯塔德”号案（40 U.S.（15 Pet.）518，1841年）是美国最高法院审理的一起案件，起因是1839年西班牙帆船“阿米斯塔德”号上的非洲人发动起义。这是一起特殊的自由诉讼案，涉及国际外交和美国法律。历史学家塞缪尔·艾略特·莫里森在1969年称它为美国法院审理过的最重要的奴隶制案件，后来被德雷德·斯科特案超越。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的判决日期。

en.t: Verdi’s Nabucco premieres at La Scala
en.s: On March 9, 1842, Giuseppe Verdi’s opera Nabucco received its first performance at La Scala in Milan. The four-act Italian opera used a libretto by Temistocle Solera and was originally titled Nabucodonosor.

zh.t: 威尔第歌剧《纳布科》在斯卡拉歌剧院首演
zh.s: 1842年3月9日，朱塞佩·威尔第的歌剧《纳布科》在米兰斯卡拉歌剧院首演。这部四幕意大利语歌剧由特米斯托克莱·索莱拉编写脚本，最初名为《纳布科多诺索尔》。

en.t: Francisco López finds gold in Placerita Canyon
en.s: On March 9, 1842, Francisco López found gold in Placerita Canyon, in present-day California. Gold particles clung to the roots of wild onions he had gathered. The discovery led to a small gold rush several years before the much larger California Gold Rush.
en.n: The location is in present-day California, United States; it was part of Mexico in 1842.

zh.t: 弗朗西斯科·洛佩斯在普拉塞里塔峡谷发现黄金
zh.s: 1842年3月9日，弗朗西斯科·洛佩斯在今天加利福尼亚州的普拉塞里塔峡谷发现黄金，金屑附着在他采挖的野葱根部。这次发现引来一场小规模淘金热，比后来更大规模的加州淘金热早了数年。
zh.n: 地点位于今天美国加利福尼亚州，1842年时属于墨西哥。

en.s: On 9 March 1847, during the Mexican–American War, the United States military made an amphibious landing and besieged the key Mexican seaport of Veracruz. The port surrendered twenty days later. The U.S. forces then marched inland to Mexico City.

zh.s: 1847年3月9日，美墨战争期间，美军两栖登陆并围攻墨西哥的重要海港韦拉克鲁斯。港口于20天后投降，美军随后向内陆的墨西哥城进军。

en.s: The 1847 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 9, 1847, in order to elect the governor of New Hampshire. Democratic nominee and former member of the U.S. House of Representatives from New Hampshire's At-large district (Seat 3) Jared W. Williams defeated incumbent Whig governor Anthony Colby and Liberty Party nominee and former member of the New Hampshire Senate Nathaniel S.

zh.s: 1847年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月9日举行。民主党候选人贾里德·W.威廉斯曾任该州全州选区第3席联邦众议员。他击败现任辉格党州长安东尼·科尔比，以及自由党候选人、前州参议员纳撒尼尔·S.。原文在后者姓名尚未列完整时中断。

en.t: Yizhu formally takes the Qing throne as the Xianfeng Emperor
en.s: On March 9, 1850, Yizhu formally took the Qing throne following the death of his father, the Daoguang Emperor. He is known as the Xianfeng Emperor.
en.n: This records his formal accession, rather than his father’s death or the start of the following calendar year.

zh.t: 奕詝正式即位，成为咸丰帝
zh.s: 1850年3月9日，道光帝之子奕詝在父亲去世后正式即位，成为清朝皇帝，即咸丰帝。
zh.n: 这里记录正式即位，并非道光帝去世或次年改元的日期。

en.s: The 1852 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 9, 1852, in order to elect the Governor of New Hampshire. Democratic nominee and former member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives Noah Martin defeated Whig nominee Thomas E. Sawyer and Free Soil Party nominee John Atwood.

zh.s: 1852年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月9日举行。民主党候选人、前州众议员诺亚·马丁击败辉格党候选人托马斯·E.索耶，以及自由土地党候选人约翰·阿特伍德。

en.s: The Battle of Cookes Spring was a skirmish which took place between Apache raiders and the United States Army on March 9, 1857. Apache raiders were tracked through the frontier by a party of U.S. Army cavalry who intercepted the native warriors at Cooke's Spring in the Black Range of New Mexico.

zh.s: 库克泉战役是1857年3月9日阿帕奇袭击者与美国陆军之间的一场小规模战斗。一支美军骑兵部队沿边疆追踪阿帕奇袭击者，并在新墨西哥黑山山脉的库克泉截住了这些原住民战士。

en.s: A colonial election was held on 9 March 1857 to elect members to the 1st Parliament of South Australia. All 36 seats in the House of Assembly (the lower house), and all 18 seats in the Legislative Council (the upper house) were up for election. Prior to the election, Boyle Travers Finniss led a government which was formed to administer the election and to establish the first responsible government.

zh.s: 1857年3月9日，南澳大利亚殖民地举行选举，选出首届议会成员。众议院全部36席和立法会全部18席均进行改选。选举前，博伊尔·特拉弗斯·芬尼斯领导临时政府，负责管理选举并筹建首个责任政府。

en.s: The Battle of Celaya took place on 8 and 9 March 1858 in Celaya (in the state of Guanajuato, Mexico), an early battle of the Reform War. Fought between elements of the liberal army, under General Anastasio Parrodi, governor of Jalisco, and elements of the conservative army, commanded by General Luis G. Osollo. The victory was won by the conservative side and corresponded to the first liberal defeat.

zh.s: 塞拉亚战役于1858年3月8日至9日在墨西哥瓜纳华托州塞拉亚发生，是改革战争初期的一场战斗。交战双方分别是哈利斯科州州长阿纳斯塔西奥·帕罗迪将军率领的部分自由派军队，以及路易斯·G.奥索略将军指挥的部分保守派军队。保守派获胜，这也是自由派在战争中的首次败仗。

en.s: The 1858 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 9, 1858, in order to elect the governor of New Hampshire. Incumbent Republican governor William Haile won re-election against Democratic nominee and former United States senator from New Hampshire John S. Wells in a rematch of the previous election.

zh.s: 1858年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月9日举行。现任共和党州长威廉·黑尔再次击败民主党候选人、该州前联邦参议员约翰·S.韦尔斯，赢得连任。两人曾在上次选举中交锋。

en.s: The Battle of Salamanca took place between 9 and 10 March 1858 in Salamanca (near Guanajuato), during Mexico's War of Reform (1858–1860). Elements of the liberal army, under General Anastasio Parrodi, governor of the Jalisco, fought with Generals Leandro Valle, Santos Degollado, and Mariano Moret, against conservatives, commanded by General Luis G. Osollo. Osollo's army had some 5,000 men, including Generals Miguel Miramón and Tomás Mejía, Francisco García Casanova.

zh.s: 1858年3月9日至10日，墨西哥改革战争期间，自由派军队与保守派军队在萨拉曼卡（今瓜纳华托附近）交战。自由派一方由哈利斯科州长阿纳斯塔西奥·帕罗迪将军、莱安德罗·巴列、桑托斯·德戈利亚多和马里亚诺·莫雷特将军率领；保守派由路易斯·G·奥索略将军指挥，约有5,000人，其中包括米格尔·米拉蒙、托马斯·梅希亚和弗朗西斯科·加西亚·卡萨诺瓦将军。

en.s: The Battle of Hampton Roads, also referred to as the Battle of the Monitor and Merrimack or the Battle of Ironclads, was a naval battle during the American Civil War. The battle was fought over two days, March 8 and 9, 1862, in Hampton Roads, a roadstead in Virginia where the Elizabeth and Nansemond rivers meet the James River just before it flows into Chesapeake Bay by the city of Norfolk.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 汉普顿锚地海战又称“监视号”与“弗吉尼亚号”海战或铁甲舰海战，是美国内战期间的一场海战，于1862年3月8日至9日在弗吉尼亚州汉普顿锚地交战。汉普顿锚地位于伊丽莎白河和南安普敦河汇入詹姆斯河之处，靠近詹姆斯河注入切萨皮克湾的诺福克市。

en.s: The 1869 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 9, 1869, in order to elect the Governor of New Hampshire. Republican nominee and former member of the New Hampshire Senate Onslow Stearns defeated Democratic nominee John Bedell.

zh.s: 1869年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月9日举行。共和党候选人、前州参议员昂斯洛·斯特恩斯击败民主党候选人约翰·贝德尔。

en.s: The 1875 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 9, 1875, in order to elect the Governor of New Hampshire. Republican nominee and former Mayor of Manchester Person Colby Cheney defeated Democratic nominee Hiram R. Roberts and Temperance nominee Nathaniel White.

zh.s: 1875年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月9日举行。共和党候选人、前曼彻斯特市长珀森·科尔比·切尼击败民主党候选人海勒姆·R.罗伯茨，以及禁酒派候选人纳撒尼尔·怀特。

en.s: The Egyptian–Ethiopian War was a war between the Ethiopian Empire and the Khedivate of Egypt, an autonomous tributary state of the Ottoman Empire, from 1874 to 1876. The conflict resulted in victory for Ethiopia and a treaty that guaranteed the country's continued independence in the years immediately preceding the Scramble for Africa.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 埃及—埃塞俄比亚战争是1874年至1876年间埃塞俄比亚帝国与埃及赫迪夫国之间的战争。埃及赫迪夫国是奥斯曼帝国的自治附属国。战争以埃塞俄比亚获胜告终；条约保障了该国在“瓜分非洲”时期到来前数年继续保持独立。

en.t: 1881 United States Senate special election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1881 United States Senate special election in Wisconsin was held in the 34th Wisconsin Legislature between March 9, 1881, and March 10, 1881. The special election was necessary to complete the unexpired term of U.S. Senator Matthew H. Carpenter, who died February 24, 1881. Former U.S. Senator Angus Cameron, who did not seek re-election in 1881 and left office just days before the special election, was elected to succeed Carpenter.

zh.t: 1881年威斯康星州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 威斯康星州第34届州议会于1881年3月9日至10日举行联邦参议员特别选举，补足马修·H.卡彭特于2月24日去世后留下的剩余任期。前联邦参议员安格斯·卡梅伦当选。卡梅伦当年没有寻求连任，刚在此次特别选举前几天卸任。

en.s: The Battle of Yingkou (Japanese: Gyūsō sakusen (牛莊作戦)) was a land battle of the First Sino-Japanese War between the forces of Meiji Japan and Qing China, fought outside the treaty port town of Yingkou, Manchuria. It is sometimes referred to as the Battle of Niuzhuang or Newchwang.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 营口战役（日语：牛庄作战）是甲午战争期间，日本明治政府军队与清军在满洲条约口岸营口城外进行的一场陆战。该战役有时也称牛庄战役或新昌战役。

en.s: The City of Wellington by-election was held on 9 March 1898 to decide the next member for that electorate in parliament. The contest was caused by resignation of Robert Stout and was won by former mayor of Wellington John Duthie.

zh.s: 惠灵顿市选区于1898年3月9日举行补选，选出该选区的新任国会议员。补选由罗伯特·斯托特辞职引起，前惠灵顿市长约翰·达西最终获胜。

en.s: The 1900 Tasmanian colonial election was held on 9 March 1900 in the Australian colony of Tasmania to elect 38 members of the Tasmanian House of Assembly. The 1900 election was the second to use the Hare-Clark system (single transferable voting) in a limited way. Hobart and Launceston were given 6 and 4 members respectively, who were elected using STV.

zh.s: 1900年3月9日，澳大利亚殖民地塔斯马尼亚举行选举，选出众议院38名议员。这是有限采用黑尔—克拉克制（单记可让渡投票制）的第二次选举。霍巴特和朗塞斯顿分别选出6名和4名议员，采用该投票制。

en.s: The Battle of Vladilovci occurred between Serbian Chetniks, Macedonian committees (IMRO) and Ottoman forces on 9 March 1907, as part of the Macedonian Struggle.

zh.s: 1907年3月9日，塞尔维亚游击队、马其顿内部革命组织与奥斯曼军队在弗拉迪洛夫齐交战。这场战斗是马其顿争夺战的一部分。

en.s: The 1907 Sheriff of London Charity Shield was the tenth and final Sheriff of London Charity Shield, Newcastle United convincingly defeated the leading amateur side Corinthian 5–2. It was replaced the next season by the FA Charity Shield. The match was however revived a few times later in the 20th century for fundraising purposes.

zh.s: 1907年伦敦治安官慈善盾是第十届，也是最后一届该项赛事。纽卡斯尔联队以5比2大胜当时实力最强的业余球队科林蒂安队。下一赛季起，这项赛事由英格兰足总慈善盾取代。20世纪后期，这场比赛曾为募款活动复办数次。

en.s: On March 9, 1908, Football Club Internazionale was founded in Milan after a split from the Milan Football and Cricket Club, now AC Milan. Its founders wanted the new club to welcome foreign players as well as Italians.

zh.t: 国际米兰足球俱乐部成立
zh.s: 1908年3月9日，一批成员从米兰足球与板球俱乐部，也就是今天的AC米兰分出，在米兰成立国际米兰足球俱乐部。他们希望新俱乐部既接纳意大利球员，也接纳外国球员。

en.s: The Battle of Columbus (Burning of Columbus or the Columbus Raid), March 9, 1916, began as a raid conducted by Pancho Villa's Division of the North on the small United States border town of Columbus, New Mexico, located 3 miles north of the border. The raid escalated into a full-scale battle between Villistas and the United States Army. Villa himself led the assault, only to be driven back into Mexico by elements of the 13th Cavalry Regiment stationed at the town. The attack angered Americans and President Woodrow Wilson ordered the Punitive Expedition in which the US Army invaded Mexico in an unsuccessful attempt to capture General Villa.

zh.s: 1916年3月9日，潘乔·比利亚的北方师突袭美国新墨西哥州边境小镇哥伦布，引发哥伦布镇战役，又称‘焚烧哥伦布镇’或‘哥伦布镇突袭’。该镇位于边境以北3英里。突袭升级为比利亚部队与美国陆军的全面交战。比利亚亲自率队进攻，最终被驻镇的第13骑兵团部分部队击退回墨西哥。袭击激怒了美国民众，伍德罗·威尔逊总统下令发动惩罚性远征，美军进入墨西哥追捕比利亚将军，但未能成功。

en.t: Portuguese seizure of Central Powers' ships
en.s: The Portuguese seizure of Central Powers' ships in 1916 was a naval operation resulting in the confiscation of 72 Austro-Hungarian and German ships by the First Portuguese Republic. Led by Captain Jaime Daniel Leote do Rego, these actions marked Portugal's entry into World War I.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 葡萄牙扣押同盟国船只
zh.s: 1916年，葡萄牙第一共和国开展海军行动，扣押了72艘奥匈帝国和德国船只。行动由海军上尉海梅·丹尼尔·莱奥特·多·雷戈率领，也标志着葡萄牙加入第一次世界大战。

en.t: First encirclement campaign against the Eyuwan Soviet
en.s: The first encirclement campaign against the Eyuwan Soviet was an encirclement campaign launched by the Chinese Nationalist Government against the Eyuwan Soviet, a Communist base located in the border region between Hubei, Henan, and Anhui provinces. The Fourth Red Army responded with its first counter-encirclement campaign and successfully defended the soviet. The Nationalist attacks lasted from November 1930 to 9 March 1931.

zh.t: 第一次围剿鄂豫皖苏区
zh.s: 中国国民政府对鄂豫皖苏区发动第一次围剿。该苏区是位于湖北、河南和安徽三省交界地带的共产党根据地。红四军随即展开第一次反围剿并成功守住苏区。国民党军的进攻从1930年11月持续到1931年3月9日。

en.s: The Emergency Banking Relief Act (E.B.R.A.) (Pub. L. 73–1, 48 Stat. 1, enacted March 9, 1933) was an act passed by the United States Congress in March 1933 in an attempt to stabilize the banking system. The act authorized the Federal Reserve to issue additional currency to banks that were deemed solvent without the requirement that these reserves be backed by gold.

zh.s: 《紧急银行救济法》（E.B.R.A.，公法73-1，48《美国法规汇编》第1页）于1933年3月通过，是美国国会为稳定银行体系而制定的法律。该法授权美联储向认定资信稳健的银行发行额外货币，而且不要求这些储备以黄金作担保。

zh.s: 1939年3月9日，英国约克郡西赖丁的巴特利与莫利下议院选区举行国会议员补选。

en.s: Operation Creek, also known as Operation Longshanks, was a covert military operation undertaken by Britain's Special Operations Executive in World War II on 9 March 1943. It involved a nighttime attack by members of the Calcutta Light Horse and the Calcutta Scottish against a German cargo ship, Ehrenfels, which had been transmitting information to U-boats from Mormugão Harbour in neutral Portugal's territory of Goa.

zh.s: 1943年3月9日，英国特别行动执行处在二战期间实施一次秘密军事行动，也称“长胫骨行动”。加尔各答轻骑兵和加尔各答苏格兰人部队夜袭停泊在中立国葡属果阿穆尔穆冈港的德国货船“埃伦费尔斯”号。该船一直向德国潜艇传递情报。

en.t: Bombing of Tallinn in World War II
en.s: During World War II, the Estonian capital Tallinn suffered from many instances of aerial bombing by the Soviet air force and the German Luftwaffe. The first bombings by Luftwaffe occurred during the Summer War of 1941 as part of Operation Barbarossa. A number of Soviet bombing missions to then German-occupied Tallinn followed in 1942–1944. The most extensive of Soviet aerial bombing campaign in Tallinn occurred on 9–10 March 1944 and is known as the 1944 March bombing (Estonian: 1944 märtsipommitamine).

zh.s: 二战期间，爱沙尼亚首都塔林多次遭到苏联空军和德国空军轰炸。德国空军在1941年夏季战争期间发动了首次轰炸，作为巴巴罗萨行动的一部分。1942年至1944年，苏联也多次轰炸当时由德国占领的塔林。1944年3月9日至10日是苏联对塔林规模最大的一轮空袭，称为“1944年三月轰炸”。

en.s: The Battle of Talasea (6–9 March 1944) was fought in the Pacific theater of World War II between Japanese and Allied forces. Dubbed "Operation Appease" by the Allies, the battle was part of the wider Operations Dexterity and Cartwheel, and took place on the island of New Britain, Territory of New Guinea, in March 1944 as primarily US forces, with limited Australian support, carried out an amphibious landing to capture the Talasea area of the Willaumez Peninsula, as part of follow-up operations as the Japanese began withdrawing east towards Rabaul following heavy fighting around Cape Gloucester earlier in the year.

zh.s: 塔拉西亚战役于1944年3月6日至9日在新几内亚领地的新不列颠岛进行，是二战太平洋战场日本军队与盟军之间的一场战斗。盟军将其称为“安抚行动”。这次战斗属于“灵巧行动”和“车轮行动”的一部分。美军为夺取威廉梅斯半岛的塔拉西亚地区实施两栖登陆，澳大利亚军队提供有限支援。此前，日军在格洛斯特角附近激战后，开始向东撤往拉包尔。

en.s: Tokyo was bombed by the United States Army Air Forces (USAAF) in a series of air raids on Japan, primarily launched during the closing campaigns of the Pacific Theatre of World War II in 1944–1945, prior to the atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki. The strikes conducted by the USAAF on the night of 9–10 March 1945, codenamed Operation Meetinghouse, constitute the single deadliest and most destructive aerial bombing raid in human history. Sixteen square miles (41 km2; 10,000 acres) of central Tokyo was destroyed, leaving an estimated 100,000 civilians dead and over one million homeless.

zh.s: 美国陆军航空队在对日作战期间多次空袭东京，主要集中在1944至1945年第二次世界大战太平洋战场的最后阶段，早于广岛和长崎原子弹爆炸。1945年3月9日至10日夜间，美军实施代号‘会议室行动’的空袭，成为人类历史上单次死亡人数最多、破坏最严重的空中轰炸。东京市中心16平方英里（41平方公里，约10,000英亩）的地区被毁，估计有10万平民死亡，超过100万人无家可归。

en.t: Japanese coup d'état in French Indochina
en.s: The Japanese coup d'état in French Indochina, known as Meigō Sakusen (明号作戦, Operation Bright Moon; Chiến dịch Giăng Sáng), was a Japanese operation that took place on 9 March 1945, towards the end of World War II. With Japanese forces losing the war and the threat of an Allied invasion of Indochina imminent, the Japanese were concerned about an uprising against them by French colonial forces.

zh.t: 日本在法属印度支那发动政变
zh.s: 1945年3月9日，二战末期，日本在法属印度支那发动政变，行动代号为“明号作战”。随着战局对日本不利，盟军可能即将入侵印度支那，日本担心法国殖民军会起义反抗。

en.s: The Granville raid occurred on the night of 8–9 March 1945 when a German raiding force from the Channel Islands landed in France and brought back supplies, Allied prisoners and former German prisoners of war to their base.

en.s: The Burnden Park disaster was a human crush that occurred on 9 March 1946 at Burnden Park football stadium, then the home of Bolton Wanderers. The crush resulted in the deaths of 33 people and injuries to hundreds of Bolton fans. It was the deadliest stadium-related disaster in British history until the Ibrox Park disaster in 1971. The match, an FA Cup Sixth Round second-leg tie between Bolton and Stoke City, was allowed to continue, with the game ending goalless. The disaster brought about the Moelwyn Hughes report, which recommended more rigorous control of crowd sizes.

zh.s: 1946年3月9日，当时作为博尔顿流浪者主场的伯恩登公园球场发生人群挤压事故，造成33人死亡，数百名博尔顿球迷受伤。在1971年伊布罗克斯公园球场惨案发生之前，这是英国历史上死亡人数最多的球场灾难。当时进行的是博尔顿对斯托克城的足总杯第六轮次回合比赛，事故发生后比赛获准继续，最终双方0比0战平。惨案促成了《莫尔温·休斯报告》，报告建议更严格地控制入场人数。

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Finland in 1946. In 1944 the Parliament had passed a law that enabled Carl Gustaf Emil Mannerheim to serve a six-year term. However, he resigned on 4 March 1946, giving as his reason his declining health and his view that the tasks he had been selected to carry out had been accomplished. An election was held in Parliament to appoint his successor.

zh.t: 芬兰举行总统选举，选出曼纳海姆的继任者
zh.s: 1946年，芬兰通过间接选举产生总统。1944年，芬兰议会通过一项法律，允许卡尔·古斯塔夫·埃米尔·曼纳海姆担任总统六年。1946年3月4日，曼纳海姆以健康状况恶化、自己获任时肩负的任务已经完成为由辞职。随后，议会选举了继任者。

en.t: CBS broadcasts Murrow’s report on Senator McCarthy
en.s: On March 9, 1954, CBS broadcast the See It Now episode “A Report on Senator Joseph R. McCarthy”. Edward R. Murrow and Fred W. Friendly used the programme to examine the senator’s methods during the anti-communist Red Scare.
en.n: This is the broadcast date, not McCarthy’s later reply or Senate censure.

zh.t: CBS播出默罗对麦卡锡的专题报道
zh.s: 1954年3月9日，CBS播出《现在请看》专题节目《关于参议员约瑟夫·R.麦卡锡的报道》。爱德华·R.默罗与弗雷德·W.弗兰德利通过这期节目审视麦卡锡在反共浪潮中使用的手段。
zh.n: 这里记录节目播出日期，并非麦卡锡后来回应或参议院谴责他的日期。

en.t: The Andreanof Islands earthquake struck Hawaii and the Aleutian Islands, causing more than $5 million in damage from ground movement and a destructive tsunami
en.s: The 1957 Andreanof Islands earthquake occurred at 04:22 local time on March 9 with a moment magnitude estimated at 8.6 and a maximum Modified Mercalli intensity of VIII (Severe). It occurred south of the Andreanof Islands group, which is part of the Aleutian Islands arc. The event occurred along the Aleutian Trench, the convergent plate boundary that separates the Pacific plate and the North American plates near Alaska.

zh.t: 安德烈亚诺夫群岛地震
zh.s: 1957年3月9日当地时间4时22分，安德烈亚诺夫群岛以南发生地震，矩震级估计为8.6级，最高麦加利烈度为VIII级（严重）。震中位于阿留申群岛弧的安德烈亚诺夫群岛以南，靠近阿留申海沟，也就是太平洋板块和北美板块交界处。这场地震影响夏威夷和阿留申群岛，地面震动和破坏性海啸造成超过500万美元损失。

en.t: The Scribner shunt is first implanted for long-term dialysis
en.s: On March 9, 1960, Clyde Shields became the first patient to receive a Scribner shunt at the University of Washington Medical Center. The device allowed repeated access to the bloodstream for dialysis, making long-term treatment possible.

zh.t: 斯克里布纳分流管首次用于长期透析
zh.s: 1960年3月9日，克莱德·希尔兹在华盛顿大学医学中心成为首位接受斯克里布纳分流管植入的患者。这种装置能反复连接血管进行透析，使长期治疗成为可能。

en.t: Sputnik 9 successfully launches, carrying a dog and a human dummy, and demonstrating that the Soviet Union was ready to begin human spaceflight
en.s: Korabl-Sputnik 4 (Russian: Корабль-Спутник 4 meaning Ship-Satellite 4) or Vostok-3KA No.1, also known as Sputnik 9 in the West, was a Soviet spacecraft which was launched on 9 March 1961. Carrying the mannequin Ivan Ivanovich, a dog named Chernushka, some mice and the first guinea pig in space, it was a test flight of the Vostok spacecraft.

zh.t: “斯普特尼克9号”成功发射，搭载狗和人体模型，表明苏联已准备好开展载人航天
zh.s: “宇宙飞船4号”（俄语：Корабль-Спутник 4，意为“飞船卫星4号”），又称“东方3KA第1号”，在西方也称“斯普特尼克9号”，是一艘苏联航天器，于1961年3月9日发射。它搭载了人体模型伊万·伊万诺维奇、一只名叫切尔努什卡的狗、几只老鼠和第一只进入太空的豚鼠，是一次东方号飞船测试飞行。

en.s: The 1967 Glasgow Pollok by-election of 9 March 1967 was held after the death of Labour Party Member of Parliament (MP) Alex Garrow. The seat was marginal, having been won by Labour at the 1966 United Kingdom general election by under 2,000 votes. Until the 1964 general election, the seat had been represented by Unionist MPs (the equivalent of Conservatives) continuously since its creation in 1918.

zh.t: 1967年格拉斯哥波洛克选区补选
zh.s: 1967年3月9日，英国格拉斯哥波洛克选区举行补选，填补工党议员亚历克斯·加罗去世后留下的空缺。这是一个竞争激烈的选区，工党在1966年大选中仅以不足2,000票的优势胜出。该选区自1918年设立至1964年大选前，一直由联合党议员代表，该党相当于苏格兰的保守党。

en.t: TWA Flight 553 collides with a light aircraft over Ohio
en.s: On March 9, 1967, a TWA DC-9 operating Flight 553 collided with a Beechcraft Baron near Urbana, Ohio, while descending towards Dayton. All 25 people aboard the DC-9 and the Beechcraft’s sole occupant were killed.

zh.t: 环球航空553号班机在俄亥俄州与小飞机相撞
zh.s: 1967年3月9日，执行环球航空553号航班的一架DC-9客机在下降前往代顿时，于俄亥俄州厄巴纳附近与一架比奇“男爵”小飞机相撞。客机上的25人和小飞机上唯一的一人全部遇难。

en.s: The 1972 Meghalaya Legislative Assembly election was held on 9 March 1972. These were Meghalaya's first Legislative Assembly elections, following the creation of the state on 21 January 1972. 59 men and one woman, Percylina Marak, were elected.

zh.s: 1972年梅加拉亚邦议会选举于3月9日举行。这是该邦于1972年1月21日成立后的首次邦议会选举，共选出59名男性和1名女性议员，唯一的女性当选者为珀西莉娜·马拉克。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Romania on 9 March 1975. The Front of Socialist Unity (FUS), dominated by the Romanian Communist Party (PCR) and including other mass organisations, was the only organisation that contested the election. No prospective candidate could run for office without the Front's prior approval. The Front won all 349 seats in the Great National Assembly.

zh.s: 罗马尼亚于1975年3月9日举行议会选举。由罗马尼亚共产党主导、包含其他群众组织的社会主义团结阵线，是唯一参加选举的组织。任何人参选都须事先获得该阵线批准。该阵线赢得大国民议会全部349席。

en.s: The 1975 Rhineland-Palatinate state election was conducted on 9 March 1975 to elect members to the Landtag, the state legislature of Rhineland-Palatinate, West Germany. Ahead of this election, the state electoral reform on 4 July 1972 reduced the constituencies from six to four: Constituency One (Wahlkreis 1) was centered around Koblenz and elected 26 members. Constituency Two (Wahlkreis 2) was centered around Trier and elected 24 members.

zh.s: 1975年3月9日，西德莱茵兰-普法尔茨州举行选举，选出州议会议员。根据1972年7月4日通过的州选举改革，选区从6个减至4个：第一选区以科布伦茨为中心，选出26名议员；第二选区以特里尔为中心，选出24名议员。

en.s: The Cavalese cable car crash is the deadliest cable car crash in history. On 9 March 1976, the steel supporting cable broke as a fully loaded cable car was descending from Mt. Cermis, near the Italian ski resort of Cavalese in the Dolomites, 40 km (25 mi) north-east of Trento. The cause of the disaster was an overlap of the carrier cable with the support cable near the first pylon, which resulted in the carrier shearing the support cable.

zh.s: 1976年3月9日，意大利多洛米蒂山脉卡瓦莱塞滑雪胜地附近，塞尔米斯山缆车下行时承重钢缆断裂。事故发生在特伦托东北约40公里（25英里）处，是历史上死亡人数最多的缆车事故。事故原因是第一根支柱附近牵引缆与承重缆重叠，牵引缆因此割断了承重缆。

They took 149 hostages and killed a radio journalist. After a 39-hour standoff, the gunmen surrendered and all remaining hostages were released from the District Building (the city hall; now called the John A.

zh.s: 1977年3月9日至11日，12名穆斯林枪手占领了华盛顿特区的三座建筑。领头者哈马斯·阿卜杜勒·哈利斯曾脱离‘伊斯兰民族’组织，因为他指责该组织犯下谋杀。枪手劫持149名人质，并杀害一名电台记者。对峙39小时后，枪手投降，剩余人质全部从特区大楼获释。这座大楼是市政厅；原文在介绍其现名称时写至‘约翰·A.’，随后中断。

en.t: President Soeharto inaugurates Jagorawi Toll Road, the first toll highway in Indonesia, connecting Jakarta, Bogor and Ciawi, West Java
en.s: The Jakarta–Bogor–Ciawi Toll Road (Indonesian: Jalan Tol Jakarta-Bogor-Ciawi) or shortened to Jagorawi Toll Road/Jalan Tol Jagorawi is the first controlled-access toll road in Indonesia. Construction of the highway began in 1973, and it was officially opened on 9 March 1978. The Jagorawi Toll Road links the capital city of Jakarta to the West Javanese cities of Bogor and Ciawi.

zh.t: 贾戈拉维收费公路通车
zh.s: 雅加达—茂物—恰维收费公路（印度尼西亚语：Jalan Tol Jakarta-Bogor-Ciawi），简称贾戈拉维收费公路，是印度尼西亚首条封闭式收费公路。公路于1973年开工，并于1978年3月9日正式通车。它连接首都雅加达与西爪哇省的茂物和恰维。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Romania on 9 March 1980. The Front of Socialist Unity and Democracy (FDUS), dominated by the Romanian Communist Party (PCR) and including other mass organisations, was the only organisation that contested the election. zh.s: 罗马尼亚于1980年3月9日举行议会选举。由罗马尼亚共产党主导、包含其他群众组织的社会主义民主和团结阵线，是唯一参加选举的组织。任何人参选都须事先获得该阵线批准。该阵线赢得大国民议会全部369席。

en.s: A regional election was held in the Basque Country on 9 March 1980 to elect the 1st Parliament of the autonomous community. All 60 seats in the Parliament were up for election. The Basque Nationalist Party (EAJ/PNV) emerged as the largest party with 25 seats, followed by People's Unity (HB) with 11 seats and the Socialist Party of the Basque Country (PSE–PSOE) with nine seats.

zh.s: 巴斯克自治区于1980年3月9日举行首届自治区议会选举，改选全部60席。巴斯克民族主义党赢得25席，成为第一大党；人民团结党获得11席，巴斯克社会党获得9席，分列其后。

en.t: Chrysler agrees to acquire American Motors
en.s: On March 9, 1987, Chrysler agreed to acquire Renault’s stake in American Motors and the company’s remaining shares in a deal valued at about $1.5 billion.
en.n: This records the acquisition agreement, not the later completion of the transaction.

zh.t: 克莱斯勒同意收购美国汽车公司
zh.s: 1987年3月9日，克莱斯勒同意收购雷诺持有的美国汽车公司股份，以及该公司的其余股份，交易估值约15亿美元。
zh.n: 这里记录收购协议达成，并非交易最终完成。

en.s: The 1989 Urban Council and Regional Council Elections were the municipal elections held on 9 March 1989 for the elected seats of the Urban Council and Regional Council respectively.

zh.t: 1989年香港市政局及区域市政局选举
zh.s: 1989年3月9日，香港举行市政局及区域市政局选举，分别选出两局的民选议员。

en.s: General elections were held in Antigua and Barbuda on 9 March 1989, the second after it had become an independent Commonwealth realm. The elections were won by the governing Antigua Labour Party (ALP), whose leader Vere Bird was reelected as prime minister. Voter turnout was 60.7%. This was Bird's eighth and final election victory. He resigned as prime minister in 1994, just before the subsequent general elections.

zh.s: 安提瓜和巴布达于1989年3月9日举行大选，这是该国独立成为英联邦王国后的第二次大选。执政的安提瓜工党获胜，党魁维尔·伯德连任总理。投票率为60.7%。这是伯德第8次、也是最后一次选举胜利。他于1994年下届大选前辞去总理职务。

en.s: Big Ass Extreme Bash was a professional wrestling doubleheader live event produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW) on the weekend of March 8 and March 9, 1996. The March 8 card was held in the Lost Battalion Hall in the Queens neighborhood of New York City, New York in the United States, while the March 9 card was held in the ECW Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania in the United States.

zh.s: ‘盛大极限狂欢’是极限冠军摔角（ECW）于1996年3月8日至9日周末举办的两场现场职业摔角赛事。3月8日的比赛在美国纽约州纽约市皇后区的失落营大厅举行；3月9日的比赛在宾夕法尼亚州费城的ECW竞技场举行。

en.s: 1996 Japanese Super Cup was the Japanese Super Cup competition. The match was played at National Stadium in Tokyo on March 9, 1996. Nagoya Grampus Eight won the championship.

zh.s: 1996年日本超级杯于1996年3月9日在东京国立竞技场举行，名古屋鲸八队夺得冠军。

en.s: The 1996 Chinese Football Super Cup (Chinese: 1996年中国足球超霸杯赛) was the 2nd Chinese Football Super Cup, contested by Chinese Jia-A League 1996 winners Dalian Wanda and 1996 Chinese FA Cup winners Beijing Guoan. Dalian Wanda beat Beijing Guoan 3–2 at Shenzhen Stadium, thus winning their first Chinese Football Super Cup title.

zh.s: 1996年中国足球超霸杯是第2届中国足球超霸杯，由1996年中国足球甲A联赛冠军大连万达队对阵1996年中国足协杯冠军北京国安队。大连万达以3比2战胜北京国安，在深圳体育场夺冠，这是该队首次赢得中国足球超霸杯。

en.t: A solar eclipse reveals Comet Hale–Bopp in the daytime sky
en.s: On March 9, 1997, a solar eclipse allowed observers in parts of China, Mongolia and eastern Siberia to see Comet Hale–Bopp during the daytime.
en.n: The locations are the reported observation regions, not the comet’s position in space.

zh.t: 日食让部分地区的观测者在白天看见海尔—波普彗星
zh.s: 1997年3月9日，日食使中国、蒙古和西伯利亚东部部分地区的观测者得以在白天看见海尔—波普彗星。
zh.n: 地点标注的是报道中的观测地区，并非彗星在太空中的位置。

en.s: A total solar eclipse occurred at the Moon's descending node of orbit between Saturday, March 8 and Sunday, March 9, 1997, with a magnitude of 1.042. A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes between Earth and the Sun, thereby totally or partly obscuring the image of the Sun for a viewer on Earth.
en.n: A total solar eclipse occurred at the Moon's descending node of orbit between Saturday, March 8 and Sunday, March 9, 1997, with a magnitude of 1.042.

zh.s: 1997年3月8日星期六至3月9日星期日，月球经过轨道降交点附近时发生一次日全食，食分为1.042。日食发生时，月球运行到地球与太阳之间，从地球上看会完全或部分遮住太阳。

en.s: General elections were held in Antigua and Barbuda on 9 March 1999. The elections were won by the governing Antigua Labour Party. Lester Bird was re-elected Prime Minister of Antigua and Barbuda. Voter turnout was 63.6%. The elections were extremely close, with the UPP losing five seats by a narrow 554 votes in total, and had the elections been free and fair (the government controlled almost all newspapers as well as television and radio stations), the opposition could have won a majority.

zh.s: 安提瓜和巴布达于1999年3月9日举行大选。执政的安提瓜工党获胜，莱斯特·伯德连任总理，投票率为63.6%。选情极为接近，联合进步党在五个选区落败，合计仅差554票。原文认为，政府控制了几乎所有报纸以及电视台和电台，假如选举自由公正，反对党可能赢得多数席位。

en.s: The 2000 South Carolina Democratic presidential caucuses took place on March 9, 2000, and was the only nominating contest that day during the Democratic Party primaries for the 2000 presidential election. The South Carolina caucus was a closed caucus, meaning that only registered Democrats could vote in this caucus, and awarded 53 delegates to the 2000 Democratic National Convention, of which 43 were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the results of the caucus.

zh.t: 2000年南卡罗来纳州民主党总统党团会议
zh.s: 2000年南卡罗来纳州民主党总统党团会议于3月9日举行，是民主党为该年总统选举挑选候选人期间，当天唯一一场提名竞选。此次为封闭式党团会议，只有登记为民主党人的选民可以投票。该州共有53个民主党全国代表大会代表名额，其中43个须按党团会议结果分配，并支持相应候选人。

en.s: The National Liberation Army (NLA) launched an attack near the village of Brest on 9 March 2001 during the insurgency in Macedonia. The NLA ambushed a Macedonian convoy, after they were defeated and forced to withdraw by KFOR troops in the village of Tanuševci.

zh.s: 2001年3月9日，马其顿叛乱期间，民族解放军在布雷斯特村附近伏击一支马其顿车队。此前，该组织在塔努舍夫齐村被科索沃维和部队击败，被迫撤离。

en.s: The 2003 by-election in the Province of Siirt was held on 9 March 2003 in order to elect three Members of Parliament from the eastern Turkish province of Siirt to the Grand National Assembly of Turkey. The by-election was held four months after the 2002 general election in November, which the Supreme Electoral Council of Turkey declared null and void in Siirt due to voting irregularities in the district of Pervari.

zh.s: 2003年3月9日，土耳其东部锡尔特省举行补选，选出三名土耳其大国民议会议员。此前，土耳其最高选举委员会以投票违规为由，宣布2002年11月大选中锡尔特省珀尔瓦里县的选举结果无效。

en.s: The 2004 Orlando mayoral election took place on March 9, 2004. Incumbent Mayor Buddy Dyer, who was first elected in a 2003 special election, ran for re-election to a full term. He faced four opponents, including businessman Ken Mulvaney and retired police captain Sam Ings. Dyer narrowly avoided a runoff election and won a full term, receiving 51 percent of the vote to Mulvaney's 31 percent and Ings's 13 percent.

zh.s: 2004年奥兰多市长选举于3月9日举行。现任市长巴迪·戴尔在2003年的特别选举中首次当选，此次争取一个完整任期。他面对四名对手，包括商人肯·马尔瓦尼和退休警长萨姆·英斯。戴尔以51%的得票率险些触发决选，最终直接当选；马尔瓦尼和英斯分别获得31%和13%的选票。

zh.s: 2008年‘X目的地’是TNA摔角联盟举办的按次付费职业摔角赛事，于3月9日在弗吉尼亚州诺福克的Scope场馆举行。这是该系列第4届赛事，也是TNA当年安排的第3场按次付费赛事。正式赛程有8场比赛，其中2场争夺冠军头衔；开场前另举行了1场比赛。压轴赛为六人组队赛，‘意外联盟’（克里斯蒂安·凯奇、凯文·纳什和萨摩亚·乔）击败了‘安格联盟’。原文列出的后者成员为科特·安格、A.J.，随后在此处中断。

en.s: The 2008 Spanish general election was held on Sunday, 9 March 2008, to elect the 9th Cortes Generales of the Kingdom of Spain. All 350 seats in the Congress of Deputies were up for election, as well as 208 of 264 seats in the Senate. After four years of growing bipolarisation of Spanish politics, the election saw a record result for both ruling Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE) and opposition People's Party (PP), together obtaining more than 83% of the vote share—over 21 million votes—and 92% of the Congress seats.

zh.s: 2008年西班牙大选于3月9日星期日举行，选出西班牙王国第9届议会，改选众议院全部350席及参议院264席中的208席。在西班牙政治两极化持续加深四年之后，执政的西班牙工人社会党和反对党人民党均取得创纪录的成绩。两党合计获得超过83%的选票，即2,100多万票，并赢得众议院92%的席位。

en.s: The Lower Austrian state election of 2008 was held in the Austrian state of Lower Austria on 9 March 2008. They were contested by the Austrian People's Party, the Social Democratic Party of Austria, The Greens – The Green Alternative and the Freedom Party of Austria, all of whom are in the current Landtag, and a number of smaller parties. The ÖVP had earlier indicated that its preferred date would have been the 20 April 2008, though 13 April 2008 had also been considered a possible date. The newly founded party The Christians contested its first election.

zh.s: 奥地利下奥地利州于2008年3月9日举行州议会选举。参选者包括当时已在州议会拥有席位的奥地利人民党、奥地利社会民主党、绿党—绿色替代和奥地利自由党，以及若干小党。人民党此前曾表示希望在4月20日投票，4月13日也曾被视为可能的日期。新成立的‘基督徒党’首次参加选举。

en.t: New Progressive Party of Puerto Rico primaries, 2008
en.s: The 2008 New Progressive Party primaries were the primary elections by which voters of the New Progressive Party (PNP) chose its nominees for various political offices of Puerto Rico, namely the position of Governor, for the 2008 general elections. Resident Commissioner Luis Fortuño was selected as the nominee at the primary elections held on March 9, 2008. He would go on to win the 2008 general election as well.

zh.s: 2008年波多黎各新进步党初选于3月9日举行，该党选民借此为当年大选挑选各公职候选人，主要包括总督候选人。驻美国国会代表路易斯·福尔图尼奥在初选中获得提名，随后也赢得了2008年大选。

en.t: Popular Democratic Party of Puerto Rico primaries, 2008
en.s: The 2008 Popular Democratic Party primaries were the primary elections by which voters of the Popular Democratic Party (PPD) chose its nominees for various political offices of Puerto Rico for the 2008 general elections. They were held on March 9, 2008. Incumbent Governor Aníbal Acevedo Vilá faced no opposition for his candidacy, making him the official candidate for the elections.

zh.t: 2008年波多黎各人民民主党初选
zh.s: 2008年波多黎各人民民主党初选于3月9日举行，该党选民借此为当年大选挑选各公职候选人。现任总督阿尼瓦尔·阿塞韦多·比拉没有党内竞争对手，因而成为该党的正式总督候选人。

en.s: A regional election was held in Andalusia on 9 March 2008 to elect the 8th Parliament of the autonomous community. All 109 seats in the Parliament were up for election. It was held concurrently with the 2008 Spanish general election. Incumbent President Manuel Chaves from the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE–A) was re-elected for a sixth term in office with a slightly reduced majority.

zh.s: 2008年3月9日，安达卢西亚举行地区选举，选出该自治区第八届议会全部109名议员。选举与2008年西班牙大选同时举行。西班牙工人社会党安达卢西亚分部的现任自治区主席曼努埃尔·查韦斯以略微减少的多数席位再次当选，开启第六个任期。

en.s: Space Shuttle Discovery (Orbiter Vehicle Designation: OV-103) is a retired American Space Shuttle orbiter. The spaceplane was one of the orbiters from NASA's Space Shuttle program and the third of five fully operational orbiters to be built. Its first mission, STS-41-D, flew from August 30 to September 5, 1984. Over 27 years of service it launched and landed 39 times, aggregating more spaceflights than any other spacecraft as of December 2024.
en.n: Space Shuttle Discovery makes its final landing after 39 flights.

zh.t: 发现号航天飞机完成最后一次着陆
zh.s: 发现号航天飞机（轨道器编号：OV-103）是已退役的美国航天飞机轨道器，曾参与NASA航天飞机计划，也是五架正式投入使用的轨道器中第三架建成的飞船。它的首次任务STS-41-D于1984年8月30日至9月5日执行。在27年服役期间，它共完成39次发射和着陆；截至2024年12月，它执行的太空飞行次数超过任何其他航天器。
zh.n: 发现号航天飞机完成第39次飞行后最后一次着陆。

en.s: 2012 in Bellator MMA was the sixth installment of the Bellator Fighting Championships, which began on March 9, 2012. The sixth season of Bellator was originally scheduled to begin on March 2, 2012. However, the debut was pushed back a week so it began with the show on March 9, 2012. Mixed martial arts tournaments were held in five weight classes, including the bantamweight, featherweight, lightweight, welterweight and middleweight divisions.

zh.s: 2012年是Bellator格斗锦标赛的第六个赛季，原定于3月2日开赛，后来推迟一周，于2012年3月9日揭幕。该赛季举办了五个级别的综合格斗锦标赛，包括雏量级、羽量级、轻量级、次中量级和中量级。

en.s: The Maltese general election took place on Saturday, 9 March 2013. The Labour Party won a majority of seats thus defeating the Nationalist Party, which had been in power for 15 years.

zh.s: 2013年马耳他大选于3月9日星期六举行。工党赢得多数席位，击败已连续执政15年的国民党。

en.s: The 2013 Latvian Supercup was the 1st edition of the Latvian Supercup, an annual football match organised by Latvia and contested by the reigning champions of the two main Latvian club competitions, the Latvian Higher League and the Latvian Football Cup. It was played at the Celtnieks Stadium in Daugavpils, Latvia on 9 March 2013, between the 2012 Latvian Higher League winners Daugava and the 2011–12 Latvian Football Cup winners Skonto.

zh.s: 2013年拉脱维亚超级杯是该赛事的首届比赛。超级杯是拉脱维亚每年举办的足球赛事，由国内两项主要俱乐部赛事——拉脱维亚超级联赛和拉脱维亚杯——的应届冠军对阵。首届比赛于2013年3月9日在拉脱维亚陶格夫匹尔斯的采尔特涅克斯体育场举行，对阵双方为2012年超级联赛冠军道加瓦和2011—12赛季拉脱维亚杯冠军斯孔托。

en.s: The 2013 Western Australian state election was held on Saturday 9 March 2013 to elect 59 members to the Legislative Assembly and 36 members to the Legislative Council. The incumbent Liberal–National Coalition government, led by Premier Colin Barnett, won a second consecutive four-year term in government, defeating the Labor Party, led by Opposition Leader Mark McGowan, in a landslide.

zh.s: 2013年3月9日星期六，西澳大利亚州举行选举，选出立法议会59名议员和立法委员会36名议员。由州长科林·巴内特领导的现任自由党—国家党联合政府击败了由反对党领袖马克·麦高恩领导的工党，以压倒性优势赢得连续第二个四年任期。

en.s: This is a list of electoral region results for the Western Australian Legislative Council in the 2013 Western Australian state election. The Shooters, Fishers and Farmers Party won their first ever Western Australian Legislative Council seat at this election.

en.s: Lockdown (2014) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) promotion, which took place on March 9, 2014 at the BankUnited Center in Miami, Florida. It was the tenth event under the Lockdown name and first event in the 2014 TNA PPV schedule. From 2005 to 2012, the tradition of Lockdown events featured every match taking place inside a steel cage. However, in 2013, Lockdown was modified to featuring standard matches and cage matches were reserved only for the high profile bouts. This year Lockdown returned to being an all steel cage event.

zh.s: 2014年‘封锁’是TNA摔角联盟举办的按次付费职业摔角赛事，于3月9日在佛罗里达州迈阿密的联合银行中心举行。这是该系列第10届赛事，也是TNA当年的首场按次付费赛事。2005至2012年，‘封锁’的传统是所有比赛都在铁笼内进行。2013年加入普通比赛，仅重要对决保留铁笼形式。2014年赛事恢复了全部比赛都在铁笼内进行的安排。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 2 February 2014, with a second round held on 9 March since no candidate won an outright majority. The primary candidates were Vice-President Salvador Sánchez Cerén of the FMLN, San Salvador Mayor Norman Quijano of ARENA, and former President Antonio Saca. Saca represented the Grand Alliance for National Unity, the National Coalition Party, and the Christian Democratic Party in the Unity coalition.

zh.s: 萨尔瓦多于2014年2月2日举行总统选举。由于没有候选人获得过半票数，第二轮投票于3月9日举行。主要候选人是法拉本多·马蒂民族解放阵线副总统萨尔瓦多·桑切斯·塞伦、圣萨尔瓦多市长诺曼·基哈诺，以及前总统安东尼奥·萨卡。萨卡代表大团结民族联盟、民族联盟党和基督教民主党组成的团结联盟参选。

en.s: On 9 March 2015, two Eurocopter AS350 Écureuil helicopters collided mid-air near Villa Castelli, Argentina, killing all ten people on board both aircraft. The helicopters had just departed together from the same spot and collided during the initial climb-out. They were transporting production staff and French sports stars participating in the French reality TV series Dropped. Among the victims were French sailor Florence Arthaud, swimmer Camille Muffat and boxer Alexis Vastine.

zh.t: 2015年比利亚卡斯特利直升机相撞事故
zh.s: 2015年3月9日，两架欧洲直升机公司AS350“松鼠”直升机在阿根廷比利亚卡斯特利附近空中相撞，机上10人全部遇难。两架直升机刚从同一地点起飞，在爬升初期相撞。机上人员包括法国真人秀节目《Dropped》的制作人员和法国体育明星，遇难者中有法国帆船运动员弗洛朗斯·阿尔托、游泳运动员卡米耶·穆法和拳击手阿列克西·瓦斯坦。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Kiribati on 9 March 2016. The result was a victory for Taneti Mamau of the Tobwaan Kiribati Party, who received 60% of the vote, with Rimeta Beniamina (United Coalition Party, but nominated by Pillars of Truth) on 38.6% and Tianeti Ioane (also Pillars of Truth) 1.5%.

zh.s: 基里巴斯于2016年3月9日举行总统选举。关爱基里巴斯党的塔内希·马茂以60%的得票率获胜。里梅塔·贝尼亚米纳获得38.6%的选票，他属于联合联盟党，但由真理支柱党提名；同属真理支柱党的蒂亚内蒂·约阿内获得1.5%。

en.s: The Idlib Governorate clashes (January–March 2017), were military confrontations between Ahrar al-Sham and their allies on one side and the al-Qaeda-aligned Jabhat Fatah al-Sham (which disbanded in 28 January and joined Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham) and their allies on the other. zh.t: 伊德利卜省冲突（2017年1月至3月）
zh.s: 2017年1月至3月的伊德利卜省冲突，是一方的沙姆自由人组织及其盟友，与另一方的基地组织关联组织沙姆征服阵线（Jabhat Fatah al-Sham，JFS）及其盟友之间的军事冲突。沙姆征服阵线于1月28日解散，并加入沙姆解放组织（Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham）。2月7日后，阿克萨士兵团也加入冲突，成为第三方交战力量。该组织已改名为阿克萨旅，并攻击其他参战方。

en.s: The 2019 Taraba State gubernatorial election occurred on March 9, 2019. Incumbent People's Democratic Party Governor Darius Ishaku won re-election for a second term in 12 local government areas, defeating former acting governor and All Progressives Congress's Sani Danladi who won in the remaining four with a margin of 157,69[8] votes, and several minor party candidates. Darius Dickson Ishaku emerged unopposed in the People's Democratic Party gubernatorial primary as the sole candidate.

zh.s: 2019年塔拉巴州州长选举于3月9日举行。人民民主党的现任州长达里乌斯·伊沙库在12个地方政府辖区胜出，赢得第二个任期，击败全体进步大会党的前代理州长沙尼·丹拉迪及数名小党候选人。丹拉迪在其余4个辖区胜出。原文所列两人的票差为‘157,69[8]票’，数字含有排版或引用错误，无法确定准确值。达里乌斯·迪克森·伊沙库在人民民主党州长初选中是唯一候选人，无竞争获得提名。

en.s: The 2019 Zamfara State gubernatorial election occurred on 9 March 2019. APC's Mukhtar Shehu Idris polled 67.41% of the total popular votes, defeating PDP's Bello Matawalle who got 23.89% of the total votes and trailed behind by a margin of 345,089 votes, and several minor party candidates. APC swept the entire 14 LGAs of the state, winning in all.

zh.s: 2019年扎姆法拉州州长选举于3月9日举行。全体进步大会党的穆赫塔尔·谢胡·伊德里斯获得67.41%的选票，击败人民民主党的贝洛·马塔瓦莱及数名小党候选人。马塔瓦莱获得23.89%，落后345,089票。全体进步大会党在全州14个地方政府辖区全部胜出。

en.t: 2019 Enugu State House of Assembly election
en.s: The 2019 Enugu State House of Assembly election was held on March 9, 2019, to elect members of the Enugu State House of Assembly in Nigeria. All the 24 seats were up for election in the Enugu State House of Assembly. PDP won all the 24 available seats.

zh.s: 尼日利亚埃努古州于2019年3月9日举行州议会选举，改选全部24席。人民民主党赢得所有席位。

en.s: The 2019 Kwara State gubernatorial election occurred on March 9, 2019. APC's AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq polled 73.12% of the total votes, ahead of PDP's Razak Atunwa who got 25.31% of votes trailing behind by a margin of 216,792 votes, and several minor party candidates. APC won in all 16 LGAs of the state. AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq from Kwara Central senatorial district emerged winner at the gubernatorial primary after defeating Yammah Abdullahi.

zh.s: 2019年夸拉州州长选举于3月9日举行。全体进步大会党的阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·阿卜杜勒拉扎克获得73.12%的选票，领先人民民主党的拉扎克·阿通瓦及数名小党候选人。阿通瓦得票率为25.31%，落后216,792票。全体进步大会党在全州16个地方政府辖区全部胜出。来自夸拉中央参议员选区的阿卜杜勒拉扎克，此前在州长初选中击败亚马·阿卜杜拉希，获得提名。

en.t: 2019 Ogun State House of Assembly election
en.s: The 2019 Ogun State House of Assembly election was held on March 9, 2019, to elect members of the Ogun State House of Assembly in Nigeria. All the 26 seats were up for election in the Ogun State House of Assembly. APC won 15 seats, APM won 7 seats, ADC won 3 seats, while PDP won 1 seat.

zh.s: 尼日利亚奥贡州于2019年3月9日举行州议会选举，改选全部26席。全体进步大会党赢得15席，盟友人民运动党获得7席，非洲民主大会党获得3席，人民民主党获得1席。

en.s: The 2019 Sokoto State gubernatorial election occurred in Nigeria on March 9, 2019. Incumbent Sokoto State Governor Aminu Tambuwal won re-election for a second term, defeating Ahmad Aliyu of the APC and several minor party candidates. Aminu Tambuwal was returned as the PDP candidate with Manir Dan Iya as his running mate. Ahmad Aliyu was the APC candidate with Faruk Malami Yabo as his running mate. 51 candidates contested in the election.

zh.s: 尼日利亚索科托州于2019年3月9日举行州长选举。现任州长阿米努·坦布瓦尔击败全体进步大会党的艾哈迈德·阿利尤及数名小党候选人，赢得第二个任期。坦布瓦尔代表人民民主党参选，搭档为马尼尔·丹·伊亚；阿利尤的竞选搭档为法鲁克·马拉米·亚博。此次共有51名候选人参选。

en.s: The 2019 Delta State gubernatorial election occurred on March 9, 2019. Incumbent PDP Governor Ifeanyi Arthur Okowa won re-election for a second term, defeating APC's Great Ovedje Ogboru, and several minor party candidates. Okowa won in 23 LGAs with a total of 80.17% of popular vote, while Ogboru won in the other two of the state's 25 LGAs with a total of 18.71% of popular vote having 709,336 votes less than Okowa.

zh.s: 2019年三角州州长选举于3月9日举行。人民民主党的现任州长伊费阿尼·阿瑟·奥科瓦击败全体进步大会党的格雷特·奥韦杰·奥格博鲁及数名小党候选人，赢得第二个任期。奥科瓦在全州25个地方政府辖区中的23个胜出，总得票率为80.17%；奥格博鲁在其余2个辖区胜出，获得18.71%的选票，比奥科瓦少709,336票。

en.s: The 2019 Niger State gubernatorial election occurred on March 9, 2019, in Nigeria. The APC nominee Abubakar Sani Bello won the election, defeating Umar Nasko of the PDP. Abubakar Sani Bello emerged APC gubernatorial candidate after he was returned as the sole candidate. He retained his deputy Ahmed Muhammad Ketso as his running mate. Umar Nasko was the PDP candidate with Mohammed Ndayako as his running mate. 31 candidates contested in the election.

zh.s: 尼日利亚尼日尔州于2019年3月9日举行州长选举。全体进步大会党候选人阿布巴卡尔·萨尼·贝洛击败人民民主党的乌马尔·纳斯科。贝洛作为党内唯一候选人获得州长提名，并继续选择副州长艾哈迈德·穆罕默德·凯措为竞选搭档。纳斯科的搭档为穆罕默德·恩达亚科。此次共有31名候选人参选。

en.s: The 2019 Abia State gubernatorial election occurred on March 9, 2019. Incumbent PDP Governor Okezie Ikpeazu won re-election for a second term, defeating APC's Uchechukwu Sampson Ogah, and several minor party candidates. The major contenders for the race signed a peace accord agreement in January 2019. Ikpeazu won in 11 LGAs with a total of 60.26% of popular vote, while Ogah won in four of the state's 17 LGAs with a total of 22.98% of popular vote.

zh.s: 2019年阿比亚州州长选举于3月9日举行。人民民主党的现任州长奥凯齐耶·伊克佩阿祖击败全体进步大会党的乌切丘库·桑普森·奥加及数名小党候选人，赢得第二个任期。主要候选人于2019年1月签署了和平竞选协议。伊克佩阿祖在11个地方政府辖区胜出，总得票率为60.26%；奥加在全州17个辖区中的4个胜出，总得票率为22.98%。

en.s: The 2019 Plateau State gubernatorial election in Nigeria occurred on March 9, 2019. Incumbent APC Governor Simon Lalong won re-election for a second term, defeating PDP Jerry Useni and several minor party candidates. Simon Lalong emerged APC gubernatorial candidate after he was returned as the sole candidate. He picked Sonni Gwanle Tyoden as his running mate.

zh.s: 尼日利亚高原州于2019年3月9日举行州长选举。全体进步大会党的现任州长西蒙·拉隆击败人民民主党的杰里·乌塞尼及数名小党候选人，赢得第二个任期。拉隆作为党内唯一候选人获得州长提名，并选择索尼·关勒·蒂奥登为竞选搭档。

en.s: The 2019 Katsina State gubernatorial election occurred in Nigeria on 9 March 2019. Incumbent APC Governor Aminu Bello Masari won re-election for a second term, defeating PDP Garba Yakubu Lado and 16 other party candidates. Aminu Bello Masari emerged APC gubernatorial candidate after scoring 5,562 votes and defeating his closest rival, Abubakar Isa, who received 8 votes. He picked Mannir Yakubu as his running mate.

zh.s: 尼日利亚卡齐纳州于2019年3月9日举行州长选举。全体进步大会党的现任州长阿米努·贝洛·马萨里击败人民民主党的加尔巴·雅库布·拉多及其他16个政党的候选人，赢得第二个任期。在党内州长初选中，马萨里获得5,562票，击败最接近的对手阿布巴卡尔·伊萨，后者仅获8票。他选择曼尼尔·雅库布为竞选搭档。

en.s: The 2019 Kebbi State gubernatorial election occurred in Nigeria on March 9, 2019. Incumbent APC Governor Abubakar Atiku Bagudu won re-election for a second term, defeating Isa Galaudu of the PDP. Abubakar Atiku Bagudu won the primary election after he was returned as the sole candidate. He picked Manasseh Daniel Jatau as his running mate.

zh.s: 尼日利亚凯比州于2019年3月9日举行州长选举。全体进步大会党的现任州长阿布巴卡尔·阿蒂库·巴古杜击败人民民主党的伊萨·加劳杜，赢得第二个任期。巴古杜作为党内唯一候选人通过初选。原文记载，他选择马纳西·丹尼尔·贾陶为竞选搭档。

en.s: The 2019 Kaduna State gubernatorial election occurred on March 9, 2019. APC candidate Nasir Ahmad el-Rufai defeated main opposition party PDP's candidate, Isah Ashiru, to emerge winner of the contest. APC was said to have won 14 LGAs, PDP nine. Nasir Ahmad el-Rufai emerged winner in the APC gubernatorial primary election unopposed. His running mate was Hadiza Sabuwa Balarabe.

zh.s: 2019年卡杜纳州州长选举于3月9日举行。全体进步大会党候选人纳西尔·艾哈迈德·鲁法伊击败主要反对党人民民主党的候选人伊萨·阿希鲁。据记载，全体进步大会党在14个地方政府辖区胜出，人民民主党在9个辖区胜出。鲁法伊在党内州长初选中没有对手，其竞选搭档为哈迪扎·萨布瓦·巴拉拉贝。

en.s: The 2019 Adamawa State gubernatorial election occurred in Nigeria on March 9, 2019. PDP candidate Ahmadu Umaru Fintiri won the election, defeating Bindo Jibrilla of the APC. Ahmadu Umaru Fintiri emerged PDP gubernatorial candidate after scoring 1,656 votes and defeating his closest rival, Mohammed Jameel who received 465 votes. He picked Martins Babale as his running mate.

zh.s: 尼日利亚阿达马瓦州于2019年3月9日举行州长选举。人民民主党候选人艾哈马杜·乌马鲁·芬蒂里击败全体进步大会党的宾多·吉布里拉。芬蒂里此前在党内州长初选中获得1,656票，击败最接近的对手穆罕默德·贾米勒，后者获得465票。原文记载，他选择马丁斯·巴巴莱为竞选搭档。

en.t: 2019 Oyo State House of Assembly election
en.s: The 2019 Oyo State House of Assembly election was held on March 9, 2019, to elect members of the Oyo State House of Assembly in Nigeria. All the 32 seats were up for election in the Oyo State House of Assembly. PDP won 26 seats, APC won 5 seats, while ADP won 1 seat.

zh.s: 尼日利亚奥约州于2019年3月9日举行州议会选举，改选全部32席。人民民主党赢得26席，全体进步大会党获得5席，行动民主党获得1席。

en.s: The 2019 Enugu State gubernatorial election was held on 9 March 2019. Ifeanyi Ugwuanyi who won his party (PDP) primaries unopposed, got re-elected for office, Choosing Hon Mrs Cecilia Ezeilo as his deputy. His rival and major opposition party the All Progressives Congress had series of court orders and counter count orders disrupting its election performance after the emergence of Ayogu Eze as its candidate, Aggrieved members formed a faction of the party which led to the party having multiple candidates in the election.

zh.s: 2019年埃努古州州长选举于3月9日举行。伊费阿尼·乌格武阿尼在人民民主党初选中无竞争获得提名，随后赢得连任，选择塞西莉娅·埃泽伊洛女士担任副州长。主要反对党全体进步大会党推举阿约古·埃泽为候选人后，接连受到相互冲突的法院裁定影响，扰乱了竞选。不满的党员另立派系，使该党在选举中出现多名候选人。

en.s: The 2019 Gombe State gubernatorial election occurred in Nigeria on 9 March 2019, the APC nominee Muhammad Inuwa Yahaya won the election, defeating Usman Bayero Nafada of the PDP. Muhammad Inuwa Yahaya emerged APC gubernatorial candidate after scoring 859 votes and defeating his closest rival, Mohammed Jibrin Barde who received 463 votes. He picked Manasseh Daniel Jatau as his running mate.

zh.s: 尼日利亚贡贝州于2019年3月9日举行州长选举。全体进步大会党候选人穆罕默德·伊努瓦·亚哈亚击败人民民主党的乌斯曼·巴耶罗·纳法达。亚哈亚此前在党内州长初选中获得859票，击败最接近的对手穆罕默德·吉布林·巴尔德，后者获得463票。他选择马纳西·丹尼尔·贾陶为竞选搭档。

en.t: 2019 Lagos State House of Assembly election
en.s: The 2019 Lagos State House of Assembly election was held on 9 March 2019, to elect members of the Lagos State House of Assembly in Nigeria. All the 40 seats were up for election in the Lagos State House of Assembly. APC won all the 40 available seats.

zh.s: 尼日利亚拉各斯州于2019年3月9日举行州议会选举，改选全部40席。全体进步大会党赢得所有席位。

en.s: The 2019 Imo State gubernatorial election in Nigeria occurred on 9 March 2019. PDP's Emeka Ihedioha polled 38.29% of the total votes, defeating AA's Uche Nwosu who got 26.66% of popular votes, and several minor party candidates. Out of 27 LGAs, Ihedioha won in 11, while Nwosu won in 10. Ihedioha emerged winner at the gubernatorial primary after defeating Samuel Anyanwu. His running mate was Gerard Iroha.

zh.s: 尼日利亚伊莫州于2019年3月9日举行州长选举。人民民主党的埃梅卡·伊赫迪奥哈获得38.29%的选票，击败获得26.66%选票的行动联盟候选人乌切·恩沃苏，以及数名小党候选人。全州27个地方政府辖区中，伊赫迪奥哈在11个胜出，恩沃苏在10个胜出。伊赫迪奥哈此前在州长初选中击败塞缪尔·阿尼安武，获得提名，竞选搭档为杰拉德·伊罗哈。

en.s: The 2019 Cross River State gubernatorial election occurred on March 9, 2019. Incumbent PDP Governor Benedict Ayade won re-election for a second term, defeating APC's John Owan Enoh, and several minor party candidates. Ayade won in all 18 LGAs of the state with a total of 73.04% of popular vote, while Enoh with no win in any LGA was his closest contestant with a total of 25.11% of popular vote having 250,323 votes less than Ayade.

zh.s: 2019年克罗斯河州州长选举于3月9日举行。人民民主党的现任州长本尼迪克特·阿亚德击败全体进步大会党的约翰·奥万·埃诺及数名小党候选人，赢得第二个任期。阿亚德在全州18个地方政府辖区全部胜出，总得票率为73.04%。埃诺未赢下任何辖区，但以25.11%的得票率成为得票最接近的对手，比阿亚德少250,323票。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Lewis vs. dos Santos
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Lewis vs. dos Santos (also known as UFC Fight Night 146 or UFC on ESPN+ 4) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that was held on March 9, 2019 at Intrust Bank Arena in Wichita, Kansas.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：刘易斯对多斯桑托斯
zh.s: ‘UFC格斗之夜：刘易斯对多斯桑托斯’又称‘UFC格斗之夜146’或‘UFC ESPN+第4场’，是终极格斗冠军赛举办的综合格斗赛事，于2019年3月9日在堪萨斯州威奇托的Intrust银行竞技场举行。

en.s: The 2019 Jigawa State gubernatorial election occurred on March 9, 2019. Incumbent APC Governor Mohammed Badaru Abubakar won re-election for a second term, defeating Aminu Ibrahim Ringim of the PDP and several minor party candidates. Mohammed Badaru Abubakar emerged APC gubernatorial candidate after scoring 3,123 votes and defeating his closest rival, Ubale Hashim, who received 54 votes. He picked Umaru Namadi as his running mate.

zh.s: 2019年3月9日，尼日利亚吉加瓦州举行州长选举。现任全体进步大会党州长穆罕默德·巴达鲁·阿布巴卡尔击败人民民主党候选人阿米努·易卜拉欣·林金和其他小党候选人，成功连任。阿布巴卡尔在党内初选中获3,123票，击败获得54票的最接近对手乌巴莱·哈希姆，成为该党候选人。他选择乌马鲁·纳马迪为竞选搭档。

en.s: The 2019 Yobe State gubernatorial election occurred on March 9, 2019, the APC nominee Mai Mala Buni won the election, defeating Umar Iliya Damagum of the PDP. Mai Mala Buni emerged APC gubernatorial candidate after scoring 2,797 votes and defeating his closest rival, Sidi Karasuwa who received 23 votes. He picked Idi Barde Gubana as his running mate.

zh.s: 2019年3月9日，尼日利亚约贝州举行州长选举。全体进步大会党候选人迈·马拉·布尼击败人民民主党候选人乌马尔·伊利亚·达马古姆当选。布尼在党内初选中获2,797票，击败获得23票的最接近对手西迪·卡拉苏瓦，成为该党候选人。他选择伊迪·巴尔德·古巴纳为竞选搭档。

en.s: The 2019 Benue State gubernatorial election occurred on March 9, 2019. Incumbent PDP Governor Samuel Ortom won re-election for a second term, defeating APC Emmanuel Jime and several minor party candidates. Samuel Ortom emerged PDP gubernatorial candidate after scoring 2,210 votes and defeating his closest rival, John Tondo, who received 475 votes. He picked Benson Abounu as his running mate.

zh.s: 2019年3月9日，尼日利亚贝努埃州举行州长选举。现任人民民主党州长塞缪尔·奥托姆击败全体进步大会党候选人埃马纽埃尔·吉梅和其他小党候选人，成功连任。奥托姆在党内初选中获2,210票，击败获得475票的最接近对手约翰·通多，成为该党候选人。他选择本森·阿布努为竞选搭档。

en.s: The 2019 Nasarawa State gubernatorial election occurred on March 9, 2019, the APC nominee Abdullahi Sule won the election, defeating David Ombugadu of the PDP. Abdullahi Sule emerged APC gubernatorial candidate after scoring 926 votes and defeating his closest rival, Ahmed Wadada Aliyu, who received 519 votes. He picked Emmanuel Akabe as his running mate. David Ombugadu was the PDP candidate with Ogoshi Onawo as his running mate.

zh.s: 2019年3月9日，尼日利亚纳萨拉瓦州举行州长选举。全体进步大会党候选人阿卜杜拉希·苏莱击败人民民主党候选人大卫·奥姆布加杜当选。苏莱在党内初选中获926票，击败获得519票的最接近对手艾哈迈德·瓦达达·阿里尤，成为该党候选人。他选择埃马纽埃尔·阿卡贝为竞选搭档；奥姆布加杜则由奥戈希·奥纳沃担任竞选搭档。

en.s: The 2019 Ebonyi State gubernatorial election occurred on March 9, 2019. Incumbent PDP Governor Dave Umahi won re-election for a second term, defeating APC Sonni Ogbuoji and several minor party candidates. Dave Umahi emerged PDP gubernatorial candidate unopposed. He picked Eric Kelechi Igwe as his running mate. Sonni Ogbuoji was the APC candidate with Justin Mbam Ogodo as his running mate. 37 candidates contested in the election.

zh.s: 2019年3月9日，尼日利亚埃博尼州举行州长选举。现任人民民主党州长戴夫·乌马希击败全体进步大会党候选人索尼·奥格布奥吉和其他小党候选人，成功连任。乌马希在党内初选中无人竞争，当选该党候选人。他选择埃里克·凯莱奇·伊格韦为竞选搭档；奥格布奥吉是全体进步大会党候选人，其竞选搭档为贾斯汀·姆巴姆·奥戈多。本次选举共有37名候选人参选。

en.s: The 2019 Kano State gubernatorial election occurred on March 9, 2019. APC candidate Abdullahi Umar Ganduje won re-election for a second term, defeating PDP Abba Kabir Yusuf and other 53 candidates. Abdullahi Umar Ganduje emerged APC's candidate in the primary election as the sole candidate. He chose Nasir Yusuf Gawuna as his running mate. Abba Kabir Yusuf emerged PDP's candidate in the primary election, scoring 2,421 votes to defeat five other candidates.

zh.s: 2019年3月9日，尼日利亚卡诺州举行州长选举。全体进步大会党候选人阿卜杜拉希·乌马尔·甘杜杰击败人民民主党候选人阿巴·卡比尔·优素福及其他53名候选人，成功连任。甘杜杰在党内初选中是唯一候选人，随后选择纳西尔·优素福·加乌纳为竞选搭档。优素福在人民民主党初选中获2,421票，击败另外五名候选人，成为该党候选人。

en.s: The 2019 Oyo State gubernatorial election occurred on March 9, 2019, the PDP nominee Seyi Makinde won the election, defeating Adebayo Adelabu of the APC. Seyi Makinde emerged PDP gubernatorial candidate after scoring 2,772 votes and defeating his closest rival, Ayo Adeseun, who received 21 votes. He picked Rauf Olaniyan as his running mate. Adebayo Adelabu was the APC candidate with Samuel Egunjobi as his running mate.

zh.s: 2019年3月9日，尼日利亚奥约州举行州长选举。人民民主党候选人塞伊·马金德击败全体进步大会党候选人阿德巴约·阿德拉布当选。马金德在党内初选中获2,772票，击败获得21票的最接近对手阿约·阿德森，成为该党候选人。他选择劳夫·奥拉尼扬为竞选搭档；阿德拉布的竞选搭档则是塞缪尔·埃贡约比。

en.s: The 2019 Borno State gubernatorial election occurred on March 9, 2019, the APC nominee Babagana Umara Zulum won the election, defeating Mohammad Imam of the PDP. Babagana Umara Zulum emerged APC gubernatorial candidate after scoring 4,432 votes and defeating his closest rival, Idris Durkwa, who received 115 votes. He picked Umar Usman Kadafur as his running mate.

zh.s: 2019年3月9日，尼日利亚博尔诺州举行州长选举。全体进步大会党候选人巴巴加纳·乌马拉·祖卢击败人民民主党候选人穆罕默德·伊玛目当选。祖卢在党内初选中获4,432票，击败获得115票的最接近对手伊德里斯·杜尔夸，成为该党候选人。他选择乌马尔·乌斯曼·卡达富尔为竞选搭档。

en.s: The 2019 Lagos gubernatorial election was conducted on 9 March to choose the Governor of Lagos State. The election was held concurrently with various state level elections. Incumbent APC Governor Akinwunmi Ambode lost to the APC flag bearer Babajide Sanwo-Olu at a direct primary election in October 2018 and hence ineligible to run for second term under APC.

zh.s: 2019年3月9日，尼日利亚拉各斯州举行州长选举，与多项州级选举同时进行。现任全体进步大会党州长阿金温米·安博德在2018年10月的党内直接初选中败给该党候选人巴巴吉德·桑沃-奥卢，因此没有资格竞选连任。

en.s: The election for Governor of Ogun State took place on 9 March (postponed from 2 March). The election was held concurrently with various state-level elections. All Progressive Congress candidate Dapo Abiodun, who is a former senatorial aspirant and chairman of CAC, defeated Allied Peoples Movement candidate Adekunle Akinlade, African Democratic Congress candidate Gboyega Nasir Isiaka, Peoples Democratic Party candidate Buruji Kashamu and Action Democratic Party candidate Dimeji Bankole.

zh.s: 尼日利亚奥贡州原定于3月2日举行州长选举，后推迟至3月9日，与多项州级选举同时进行。全体进步大会党候选人达波·阿比奥敦击败盟军人民运动候选人阿德昆勒·阿金拉德、非洲民主大会候选人戈博耶加·纳西尔·伊西亚卡、人民民主党候选人布鲁吉·卡沙穆和行动民主党候选人迪梅吉·班科勒。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in South Korea on 9 March 2022. Under the South Korean constitution, presidents are restricted to a single five-year term, meaning that incumbent president Moon Jae-in was ineligible to run for a second term. Opposition candidate Yoon Suk Yeol of the People Power Party won the election, defeating candidate Lee Jae Myung of the incumbent Democratic Party.

zh.s: 韩国于2022年3月9日举行总统选举。依照韩国宪法，总统只能担任一届五年任期，因此现任总统文在寅无法竞选连任。反对党国民力量的候选人尹锡悦击败执政党共同民主党的候选人李在明，赢得选举。

en.s: As part of the Russian offensive on Kyiv during the Russian invasion of Ukraine, a battle took place for control of the city of Irpin. The combatants were elements of the Russian Armed Forces and Ukrainian Ground Forces. By 28 March 2022, Ukrainian forces recaptured the city. The battle was part of a larger operation to encircle Kyiv, the capital city of Ukraine.

en.s: The fourth presidential election of Nepal, to elect the country's third president since the abolition of the monarchy, was held on 9 March 2023. The term of the incumbent president, Bidya Devi Bhandari, first elected in 2015, was set to expire on 13 March 2023. She was term-limited and could not seek re-election, with the Constitution of Nepal barring her from doing so.

zh.s: 尼泊尔于2023年3月9日举行第四次总统选举，选出废除君主制以来的第三位总统。2015年首次当选的现任总统比迪娅·德维·班达里，任期原定于2023年3月13日届满。她已达到任期上限，按照尼泊尔宪法不能再次竞选。

en.s: On 9 March 2023, a mass shooting occurred at a Jehovah's Witnesses Kingdom Hall in the Alsterdorf quarter of Hamburg, Germany. The shooter, identified as 35-year-old Philipp Fusz, entered the building after a service was held there and opened fire, killing six people and injuring eight others, before killing himself minutes later. One of the fatalities was pregnant, leading to the foetus's loss.

zh.s: 2023年3月9日，德国汉堡阿尔斯特多夫区的一处耶和华见证人王国聚会所发生大规模枪击。35岁的菲利普·富斯在礼拜结束后进入建筑开枪，造成6人死亡、8人受伤，并于几分钟后自杀。其中一名死者为孕妇，胎儿也未能幸存。

en.s: Presidential Elections were held in Pakistan on 9 March 2024 to select the 14th President of Pakistan, who is the country's head of state. Asif Ali Zardari of the Pakistan People's Party was elected as 14th President of Pakistan, defeating Mahmood Khan Achakzai of the PTI-backed Sunni Itehad Council (SIC) alliance. Former President Arif Alvi was eligible for re-election but did not contest for a second term.

zh.s: 巴基斯坦于2024年3月9日举行总统选举，选出担任国家元首的第14任总统。巴基斯坦人民党的阿西夫·阿里·扎尔达里击败马哈茂德·汗·阿查克扎伊当选。阿查克扎伊代表逊尼派团结委员会联盟，该联盟得到巴基斯坦正义运动党支持。前总统阿里夫·阿尔维有资格连任，但未竞选第二个任期。

en.t: 2025 Liberal Party of Canada leadership election
en.s: From February 26 to March 9, 2025, members of the Liberal Party of Canada voted on a successor for Justin Trudeau after he announced his intent to resign as the party leader and prime minister of Canada. Mark Carney, the former governor of the Bank of Canada, won the ranked-choice voting (RCV) election with over 85% of the first-preference vote and points, as well as a majority in all 343 ridings.

zh.s: 2025年2月26日至3月9日，加拿大自由党党员投票选出贾斯汀·特鲁多的继任者。特鲁多此前宣布辞去党魁和总理职务。加拿大央行前行长马克·卡尼在排序选择投票中胜出，首选票和计分票均超过85%，并在全部343个选区获得多数支持。
